findings.riskAnalysis: Hardcoding state to 'Central' and examCategory to 'category_pending' in parse methods causes unconfigured missions to appear in Central filters and absorb all category queries.
Any mission retaining 'category_pending' matches EVERY single student category filter, polluting Teaching, Engineering, and Civil Services buckets.
Missions missing state default to 'Central' rather than throwing or marking unassigned. Fixed 0.6 examDifficulty bypasses dynamic forecasting.
UI realm selector displays 'category_pending' missions in all categories. Once NEET is repaired to 'medical', this leak is sealed at the data tier without requiring immediate UI rewrites.

remediationStrategy.backendTier: Eliminate category_pending and missing states at Firestore document level (Gate 48B1 Batch-0).
remediationStrategy.clientTier: In future client refactor, replace category_pending with strict enum parsing and replace fixed 0.6 difficulty with dynamic model values.
